region: us-east-1 AWS origin; US/Mexico/Canada CloudFront viewers
basis: Public pay-as-you-go first-tier list prices, no free allowances or negotiated discounts; model inputs, not verified account charges.
notes: S3 first 50 TB tier. DynamoDB Standard on-demand, strongly consistent reads, transaction writes counted per item.
Lambda x86 first 6 billion GB-seconds tier. Existing API memory is 256 MiB, timeout 15 seconds. Billed INIT and invocation duration are unmeasured.

CloudFront price follows viewer geography, not origin region. AWS origin to CloudFront transfer is zero; do not charge S3 internet egress again. Ingestion bodies can incur CloudFront-to-origin upload transfer.

One viewer-request Function invocation per modeled API request, not two for two configured behaviors. No KVS calls exist in the current function. Static asset requests and their function executions are not in the workload.

Failed ordinary conditional writes consume write units based on existing item size, minimum one. Transaction ConditionCheck is modeled using the general two-writes-per-item rule; absent-item minimum is an assumption. Canceled transactions conservatively count all submitted actions.

Log storage uses compressed retained bytes, separately assumed from ingested bytes. Secret fixed monthly cost and unmeasured full authentication costs belong in shared/auth sensitivity, not hidden zero-cost assumptions.

Stripe assumes a US merchant and successful domestic card. Actual merchant location, contract, refund/dispute/international/FX costs and Billing usage are unverified. Applying 0.7 percent to subscription volume is hypothetical, not activation.
